description: The one list of errors, warnings and events this platform raises (ADR-062). Edit this file, then run: node scripts/error-dictionary.mjs --write

entries.title: An account with that email already exists
entries.description: The email address already belongs to an account, so a second cannot be created.
entries.action: Use a different address, or sign in with the existing account.

entries.title: Administrators only
entries.description: Only a platform administrator can manage staff.
entries.action: Ask a platform administrator.

entries.title: Two kinds of credentials sent
entries.description: The request carried both an API key and a bearer token, so it is unclear which identity is calling.
entries.action: Send one credential: either the API key headers or a bearer token.

entries.title: API key could not be checked
entries.description: The service that checks API keys is not answering. This says nothing about whether the key is valid.
entries.action: Retry after the Retry-After interval. If it keeps failing, report the correlation id.

entries.title: API key not accepted
entries.description: The API key is missing, unknown, malformed or revoked, or its signature could not be checked. The reasons are not told apart on purpose.
entries.action: Check the key, and that it was copied whole. Issue a new key in the DF Console if it was revoked.

entries.title: API key not found
entries.description: No API key with that id belongs to this fiduciary.
entries.action: List the fiduciary's keys and use an id from that list.

entries.title: API key already revoked
entries.description: The key was revoked earlier, and a revoked key cannot be changed or used.
entries.action: Issue a new key if one is needed.

entries.title: Not allowed to read the audit
entries.description: Only Owners, Administrators and Auditors of the fiduciary, and platform staff, read the audit.
entries.action: Ask someone with that role.

entries.title: Entry not anchored yet
entries.description: The entry is not part of a timestamped checkpoint yet, so it has no proof.
entries.action: Try again after the next checkpoint.

entries.title: Batch not found
entries.description: No batch with that id belongs to this fiduciary.
entries.action: List the batches and use an id from it.

entries.title: The month has not ended
entries.description: Invoices are issued for calendar months (UTC) that have ended.
entries.action: Run the invoices after the month ends.

entries.title: Administrators are managed elsewhere
entries.description: Platform administrators are managed in Keycloak, not through this service.
entries.action: Change them in Keycloak.

entries.title: You cannot change your own role
entries.description: People cannot change or remove their own account here.
entries.action: Ask another Owner or Administrator.

entries.title: Consent has lapsed
entries.description: The consent's validity ended.
entries.action: Ask for consent again.

entries.title: Consent is not active
entries.description: The consent has been withdrawn or has lapsed, so its token cannot be refreshed.
entries.action: Ask for consent again.

entries.title: Consent not found
entries.description: No consent with that id is visible to the caller.
entries.action: Check the id.

entries.title: Consent is not in force
entries.description: The consent is not in force, so it cannot be changed.
entries.action: Read the consent's state first.

entries.title: Consent is not in force
entries.description: The consent was never given, or has been withdrawn, so this cannot be done.
entries.action: Read the consent's state first.

entries.title: Consent not found
entries.description: The person has no consent with that id.
entries.action: Choose one of your consents.

entries.title: Request not yet linked to a person
entries.description: The request was sent to an address the person has not signed in with yet, so it cannot be decided.
entries.action: The person must sign in with the address it was sent to.

entries.title: Consent request not found
entries.description: No consent request with that id is visible to the caller.
entries.action: Check the id.

entries.title: Consent request already decided
entries.description: The request was already given, refused or withdrawn.
entries.action: Read its current state; raise a new request if needed.

entries.title: Confirmation needed
entries.description: Closing an account needs the confirmation words typed exactly.
entries.action: Type the words the page asks for.

entries.title: Consent could not be checked
entries.description: The policy decision point could not answer in time or is unavailable. This is not a decision.
entries.action: Retry after the Retry-After interval; do not treat it as a refusal or as permission.

entries.title: Consent not verified
entries.description: The consent behind this call could not be confirmed: it is missing, withdrawn, lapsed, for another purpose or fiduciary, or the token was altered.
entries.action: Do not process the personal data. Ask the person for consent again if it is still needed.

entries.title: Contact not verified
entries.description: The sign-in did not verify an email address or number to claim requests with.
entries.action: Sign in again with a code sent to your own address.

entries.title: That is not your address
entries.description: Requests can only be claimed for the address you signed in with.
entries.action: Claim requests with your own address.

entries.title: Webhook delivery not found
entries.description: No delivery with that id belongs to this fiduciary.
entries.action: List the deliveries and use an id from it.

entries.title: Delivery still being tried
entries.description: The delivery has not finished, so it cannot be replayed yet.
entries.action: Wait until it is delivered or failed.

entries.title: A service is unavailable
entries.description: A service this call depends on is not answering and its circuit breaker is open. The request was not attempted.
entries.action: Retry after the Retry-After interval.

entries.title: Activate the fiduciary first
entries.description: Its team can only be managed once the fiduciary has been activated.
entries.action: Activate the fiduciary, then try again.

entries.title: API client not found
entries.description: The fiduciary has no API client; it is created when the fiduciary is activated.
entries.action: Activate the fiduciary first.

entries.title: Fiduciary not active
entries.description: The fiduciary is registered but not active, or has been suspended, so it cannot act yet.
entries.action: Activate the fiduciary, or contact the platform if it was suspended.

entries.title: Fiduciary not found
entries.description: No fiduciary with that id exists.
entries.action: Check the id.

entries.title: Subscription not found
entries.description: The fiduciary has no subscription yet; it starts when the fiduciary is activated.
entries.action: Activate the fiduciary first.

entries.title: For data principals only
entries.description: Only a person has push devices.
entries.action: Sign in as the person.

entries.title: Request already closed
entries.description: The request was already answered, refused or withdrawn.
entries.action: Read its current state.

entries.title: Request not found
entries.description: No request with that id is visible to the caller.
entries.action: Check the id.

entries.title: Already asked
entries.description: The person already has this request open for this consent.
entries.action: Wait for the answer, or withdraw the open one.

entries.title: Draft not found
entries.description: The purpose has no draft.
entries.action: Draft a change first.

entries.title: Erasure not found
entries.description: No erasure with that id exists.
entries.action: List the erasures and use an id from it.

entries.title: Erasure is not stuck
entries.description: Only a stuck erasure can be retried.
entries.action: Read its state first.

entries.title: Account is already being closed
entries.description: An erasure for this account is already under way.
entries.action: Wait for it to finish.

entries.title: Something went wrong on our side
entries.description: An unexpected error stopped the request. Nothing about it is shown here, to avoid giving details away; the service logged it with the correlation id.
entries.action: Retry once. If it happens again, report the correlation id to the platform.

entries.title: The service key is missing or wrong
entries.description: A request to send a sign-in code did not carry the key cm-ntf-svc asks for, or carried a different one.
entries.action: Set the same value as cm-ntf-svc's cm.ntf.internal-api-key in Keycloak's ntf-api-key server setting.

entries.title: Answer not valid
entries.description: An answer needs a reply, and a refusal also needs its legal ground. The detail says which.
entries.action: Add what is missing.

entries.title: API key request not valid
entries.description: The request to issue an API key was refused. The detail says why.
entries.action: Correct the request as the detail says.

entries.title: Batch not valid
entries.description: The batch request was refused. The detail says why.
entries.action: Correct the batch as the detail says.

entries.title: Change not valid
entries.description: The change to the consent or purpose was refused. The detail says why.
entries.action: Correct the change as the detail says.

entries.title: Count out of range
entries.description: The number of requests to reserve or release must be from 1 to 100,000.
entries.action: Send a count in range.

entries.title: A credit note needs a reason
entries.description: The reason is missing or longer than 500 characters.
entries.action: Give a reason of up to 500 characters.

entries.title: Decision not valid
entries.description: A decline needs a reason, or the note was too long.
entries.action: Say why the request is declined, in the note.

entries.title: Fiduciary id not valid
entries.description: A fiduciary id must be a UUID.
entries.action: Use the id as given by the platform.

entries.title: Fiduciary profile not valid
entries.description: A field of the fiduciary's profile was refused. The detail names it.
entries.action: Correct the profile field named in the detail.

entries.title: Request not valid
entries.description: The request is missing its consent or details, or they are too long. The detail says which.
entries.action: Correct the request as the detail says.

entries.title: Choice not valid
entries.description: The data or validity the person chose is not allowed for this request. The detail says why.
entries.action: Choose within what the request offers.

entries.title: Kind of request not recognised
entries.description: The kind of request must be RELAY or GRIEVANCE.
entries.action: Use one of them.

entries.title: Recipient list not valid
entries.description: The recipient list could not be read. The detail says why.
entries.action: Correct the list as the detail says.

entries.title: Logo not valid
entries.description: The logo is not a supported image.
entries.action: Upload a PNG, JPEG or SVG logo.

entries.title: Team member not valid
entries.description: A required field of the new member is missing or not valid. The detail names it.
entries.action: Correct the field named in the detail.

entries.title: The month is not valid
entries.description: The month is not in the form yyyy-MM, for example 2026-10.
entries.action: Send the month as yyyy-MM.

entries.title: Operator not valid
entries.description: A required field of the new operator is missing or not valid.
entries.action: Correct the field named in the detail.

entries.title: Parameter not valid
entries.description: A query parameter has the wrong form. The detail names it.
entries.action: Correct the parameter.

entries.title: Month not valid
entries.description: A month is written like 2026-11.
entries.action: Use that form.

entries.title: Plan change request not valid
entries.description: The request names no plan, the plan the fiduciary already has, or a note that is too long.
entries.action: Choose a different plan and keep the note short.

entries.title: The price is not valid
entries.description: A monthly price is a whole number of minor units from 0 up to a thousand million.
entries.action: Send monthlyMinor as a non-negative whole number.

entries.title: Processor is not valid
entries.description: The name, role, country or contact of the processor is missing or malformed.
entries.action: Give a name of up to 200 characters, a role of up to 500, a two-letter ISO country code and an email address for the contact.

entries.title: Purpose not valid
entries.description: The purpose or its content was refused. The detail names what is wrong.
entries.action: Correct what the detail names.

entries.title: Request not valid
entries.description: The request is missing something it needs, or a value is not valid. The detail says which.
entries.action: Correct the request as the detail says.

entries.title: Right not recognised
entries.description: The right asked for is not one of access, correction, erasure, grievance or nomination.
entries.action: Use one of the listed rights.

entries.title: Status not recognised
entries.description: The status filter is not one of the values this list has.
entries.action: Use one of the listed values.

entries.title: Webhook endpoint not valid
entries.description: The endpoint's address, its message types or the request body was refused. The detail says why.
entries.action: Correct the endpoint as the detail says.

entries.title: The invoice cannot be credited
entries.description: The invoice has been credited already, or is a credit note.
entries.action: Read the credit note that exists; an invoice is credited once.

entries.title: Invoice not found
entries.description: There is no such invoice for the caller.
entries.action: List the invoices and use one of their ids.

entries.title: The invoice cannot be marked paid
entries.description: Only an invoice that is still issued is marked paid.
entries.action: Read the invoice: it may be paid or credited already.

entries.title: A fiduciary must keep an Owner
entries.description: The change would leave the fiduciary without an Owner, which is not allowed.
entries.action: Make someone else an Owner first.

entries.title: Recipient list too large
entries.description: The file is larger than 5 MB or has more recipients than a batch allows.
entries.action: Split the list.

entries.title: Logo too large
entries.description: The logo is larger than allowed.
entries.action: Upload a smaller image.

entries.title: Request could not be read
entries.description: The body, a parameter or a header could not be understood: for example JSON that does not parse, or a value of the wrong type.
entries.action: Check the request against the API description.

entries.title: Not allowed to answer requests
entries.description: Only an Owner, an Administrator or a Consent manager answers requests, and platform staff answer grievances.
entries.action: Ask someone with that role.

entries.title: Not allowed to ask for a plan change
entries.description: Only an Owner or an Administrator of the fiduciary can ask for another plan, or withdraw the request.
entries.action: Ask an Owner or Administrator.

entries.title: Team member not found
entries.description: No member with that id belongs to this fiduciary.
entries.action: List the team and use an id from it.

entries.title: No draft to publish
entries.description: The purpose has no draft, so there is nothing to publish.
entries.action: Draft a change first.

entries.title: No valid recipients
entries.description: None of the rows in the list was a usable email address or number.
entries.action: Check the list, and that its contact column is named.

entries.title: For data principals only
entries.description: Only a person signed in to the DP portal or app can do this.
entries.action: Sign in as the person concerned.

entries.title: For fiduciaries only
entries.description: The caller is not signed in as a fiduciary.
entries.action: Use a fiduciary's account or API client.

entries.title: For people at a fiduciary only
entries.description: This is for a person signed in to the DF Console, not for a system or API key.
entries.action: Sign in to the DF Console.

entries.title: Not a test contact
entries.description: In the sandbox, requests can only go to contacts reserved for testing.
entries.action: Use a test contact from the developer docs.

entries.title: Not permitted for this caller
entries.description: This action needs a person with the right role at the fiduciary, not a system or API key, or a different role.
entries.action: Ask someone with the required role.

entries.title: Platform administrators only
entries.description: Only a platform administrator can approve or decline plan changes.
entries.action: Ask a platform administrator.

entries.title: Platform staff only
entries.description: Only platform administrators and operators can do this.
entries.action: Ask platform staff.

entries.title: Billing could not be reached
entries.description: A fiduciary's departure could not be called off because Billing, which must bill it again, did not answer in time. Nothing was changed: the fiduciary is still leaving, and the one cancellation is not used up.
entries.action: Try again in a moment. If it keeps failing, platform staff check cm-bil-svc.

entries.title: Drafting with a model is not switched on
entries.description: The platform has no drafting model set up (cm.cnscmd.ai-drafting.enabled is off), so a purpose cannot be drafted from a description.
entries.action: Write the purpose by hand, or ask whoever runs the platform to set up a model (ADR-111).

entries.title: The description seems to hold personal data
entries.description: The text to draft from looks like it holds an email address, a phone, a PAN, an Aadhaar-shaped or a card number. The drafting model is not where anyone's data goes, so the request was refused and nothing was sent to it.
entries.action: Describe the purpose in general words, with no one's details, and ask again.

entries.title: Too many drafts asked for
entries.description: This fiduciary has asked for as many model drafts in the last hour as it may.
entries.action: Wait and ask again later, or write the purpose by hand.

entries.title: The drafting model is busy
entries.description: The model is already working on as many drafts as this instance allows at once.
entries.action: Try again in a moment.

entries.title: The model's draft was not usable
entries.description: The model answered twice, and neither answer passed the rules a purpose must meet (not JSON, no data listed, no notice, a field out of bounds). Nothing was kept.
entries.action: Describe the purpose a little differently, or write it by hand.

entries.title: The drafting model could not be reached
entries.description: The model endpoint did not answer in time or refused the connection.
entries.action: Try again shortly. If it keeps failing, whoever runs the platform checks the model server (runbook: AI drafting).

entries.title: A sign-in code request is missing something
entries.description: The request to send a sign-in code had no body, or no channel, destination or code. It comes from Keycloak's sign-in step, which always sends all three, so a request like this is something else calling the endpoint or a mistake in a change.
entries.action: Send a channel, a destination and the code. If Keycloak sent it, look at the sign-in step's version against the notification service's.

entries.title: Too many sign-in codes sent
entries.description: The notification service has sent as many sign-in codes to this address or number, or by this channel, as it allows in the hour or day, whoever asked. The sign-in is told to wait.
entries.action: Wait and ask for a code again later; do not retry in a loop. If it is a real person, they can use the code already sent.

entries.title: The fiduciary already has an Owner
entries.description: A fiduciary has one Owner, who manages its team.
entries.action: Ask the Owner to add people.

entries.title: Request body too large
entries.description: The request body is larger than the gateway accepts.
entries.action: Send a smaller body, or split it.

entries.title: Plan change already decided
entries.description: The request was already approved, declined or withdrawn.
entries.action: Read its current state; nothing more to do.

entries.title: Plan change request not found
entries.description: No plan change request with that id is visible to the caller.
entries.action: List the requests and use an id from the list.

entries.title: A plan change is already waiting
entries.description: The fiduciary already has a plan change request waiting for a decision.
entries.action: Withdraw the waiting request to ask for another plan.

entries.title: For the person only
entries.description: Only the person the consent is about can do this, not the fiduciary or its systems.
entries.action: Ask the person to do it themselves.

entries.title: Processor already registered
entries.description: A processor with that name is already in the fiduciary's register (names are compared ignoring case).
entries.action: Use the existing entry, or choose a different name.

entries.title: Processor not found
entries.description: There is no such processor in the fiduciary's register.
entries.action: List the register and use one of its ids.

entries.title: Processor is retired
entries.description: A purpose draft or publication names a processor that has been retired from the register.
entries.action: Remove it from the recipients and transfers, or reinstate the processor.

entries.title: Purpose already exists
entries.description: A purpose with that code exists already.
entries.action: Draft a new version of it instead of creating it again.

entries.title: Purpose not found
entries.description: The fiduciary has no purpose with that code.
entries.action: List the purposes and use a code from the list.

entries.title: Purpose not published yet
entries.description: The purpose has no published version to ask consent for.
entries.action: Publish the purpose first.

entries.title: Purpose version not found
entries.description: The purpose has no version with that number.
entries.action: Use a version from the purpose's published versions.

entries.title: Purpose version replaced
entries.description: A newer version of the purpose has been published since, so a request cannot name this one.
entries.action: Ask for the current version.

entries.title: Device not found
entries.description: The person has no such device.
entries.action: List the devices and use an id from it.

entries.title: Push token not valid
entries.description: The device token is missing or not valid.
entries.action: Register the device again.

entries.title: Monthly allowance used up
entries.description: The fiduciary has used its plan's whole monthly allowance, so new consent requests are refused until the month turns.
entries.action: Wait for the allowance to reset, or ask for a larger plan in the DF Console under Billing.

entries.title: Too many requests a second
entries.description: The fiduciary's plan allows only so many requests a second, and this call went over it.
entries.action: Wait for the Retry-After interval and slow down, or ask for a plan with a higher rate.

entries.title: Consent record not found
entries.description: There is no record for that consent request.
entries.action: Check the id.

entries.title: Request already used
entries.description: The nonce of this signed request was used before, so it was refused as a replay.
entries.action: Sign every request, retries included, with a new nonce.

entries.title: Role cannot take sandbox keys
entries.description: Only an Owner, an Administrator or a Developer can take sandbox keys.
entries.action: Ask one of them.

entries.title: Request signature out of date
entries.description: The signed timestamp is more than five minutes from the server's clock.
entries.action: Sign each request when it is sent, and keep the caller's clock correct.

entries.title: Request signature does not match
entries.description: The signature did not match the request as received: its method, path, query, body or secret differ from what was signed.
entries.action: Sign exactly the bytes sent, with the key's signing secret, and check the header formats.

entries.title: Request signature required
entries.description: This API key requires signed requests, and the signature headers were missing or incomplete.
entries.action: Send X-Signature-Timestamp, X-Signature-Nonce and X-Signature, signed as in the developer docs.

entries.title: Staff account not found
entries.description: No platform staff account with that id exists.
entries.action: List the staff and use an id from it.

entries.title: Subscription not active
entries.description: The fiduciary's subscription is suspended, so its monthly allowance cannot be used.
entries.action: Contact the platform to reactivate the subscription.

entries.title: Plan missing for a subscription
entries.description: A subscription refers to a plan that no longer exists. This is a data fault, not something the caller did.
entries.action: Report it to the platform with the correlation id.

entries.title: Plan not found
entries.description: There is no subscription plan with that id.
entries.action: List the plans and use one of them.

entries.title: Subscription not active
entries.description: The fiduciary's subscription is suspended or ended, so new consent requests are refused.
entries.action: Contact the platform to reactivate the subscription.

entries.title: Access token unavailable
entries.description: An access token for this fiduciary could not be obtained from the identity provider right now.
entries.action: Retry in a moment.

entries.title: Too many open requests
entries.description: A person can have at most 20 requests open at once.
entries.action: Wait for answers, or withdraw one.

entries.title: Too many webhook endpoints
entries.description: A fiduciary can have at most ten endpoints.
entries.action: Remove one you no longer use.

entries.title: Unknown plan
entries.description: There is no plan with that name.
entries.action: List the plans and use one of their names.

entries.title: List type not supported
entries.description: The file is not JSON, CSV or Excel.
entries.action: Send the list as JSON, CSV or .xlsx.

entries.title: Webhook endpoint not found
entries.description: No webhook endpoint with that id belongs to this fiduciary.
entries.action: List the endpoints and use an id from it.

entries.title: Webhook endpoint paused
entries.description: The endpoint is paused, so it cannot be sent a test.
entries.action: Resume the endpoint first.

entries.title: Account erasure stuck
entries.description: An account erasure gave up on a step after eight attempts and stopped. Part of the person's data is erased and part is not.
entries.action: Find the cause for the step named in the message and retry it in CM Admin; see docs/runbooks/erasure.md.

entries.title: Account erasure step failed
entries.description: One attempt at an erasure step failed. It is tried again every two minutes until it gives up.
entries.action: No action unless CM-ERASURE-STUCK follows; check the named step's service if it repeats.

entries.title: Invoice run failed
entries.description: The monthly invoice run for last month failed part way. Invoices already issued stay; it is tried again every hour.
entries.action: If it repeats, check the billing database and the plan prices, then run the month by hand from the admin console.

entries.title: Sign-in codes can be requested by anything on the network
entries.description: cm-ntf-svc has no internal API key, so any caller that can reach it can ask it to send sign-in codes. Logged at start-up.
entries.action: Set cm.ntf.internal-api-key (NTF_INTERNAL_API_KEY in the chart's secret) and the same value in Keycloak.

entries.title: The previous sign-in service key is still accepted
entries.description: cm-ntf-svc has cm.ntf.internal-api-key-previous set, so requests to send a sign-in code are accepted with either the current key or the old one. Logged at start-up; meant only for the time it takes to change the key (ADR-101).
entries.action: Once cm.ntf.internal.key.previous.used has stopped rising, remove NTF_INTERNAL_API_KEY_PREVIOUS from the secret and restart the service.

entries.title: Billing could not be told that a fiduciary is leaving
entries.description: A fiduciary began to leave, and cm-df-reg-svc could not reach cm-bil-svc to end its billing for the wind-down. The departure went ahead; billing is ended again when the fiduciary closes (ADR-084), so the cost is that it stays billed until then.
entries.action: Check cm-bil-svc. To stop billing now, call PUT /api/bil/dfs/{id}/billing-end as an administrator (ADR-109).

entries.title: Keycloak sends no key to cm-ntf-svc
entries.description: The sign-in step has no ntf-api-key server setting, so it asks cm-ntf-svc to send codes without a key. That works only while cm-ntf-svc does not ask for one. Logged at start-up.
entries.action: Set the ntf-api-key server setting (KC_SPI_AUTHENTICATOR_CM_OTP_AUTHENTICATOR_NTF_API_KEY) to the value of cm-ntf-svc's internal API key.

entries.title: Outbox relay pass failed
entries.description: The service could not publish waiting events to Pulsar in one pass. They stay in the outbox and are sent on the next pass.
entries.action: If it repeats, check that Pulsar is reachable and the service's database is healthy; events are not lost.

entries.title: An invoice reminder could not be raised
entries.description: The invoice reminder sweep could not raise the reminder for one overdue invoice, or the whole pass failed. It is tried again every hour, and a reminder step is recorded only once it has been raised.
entries.action: If it repeats, check the billing database and the outbox relay. A fiduciary is not told about an overdue invoice until it clears.

entries.title: Usage alert check failed
entries.description: The usage alert sweep could not check one fiduciary, or the whole pass failed. It is tried again every minute.
entries.action: If it repeats, check Redis and the billing database.

entries.title: Sign-in code refused by a limit
entries.description: A Keycloak event raised when a sign-in code was refused because of a limit across sign-ins. The detail cm_otp_limit says which: TOO_MANY_CODES, NETWORK_BUSY or TOO_MANY_WRONG_GUESSES (ADR-061).
entries.action: Alert on bursts. A burst for one address is someone being targeted; a burst of NETWORK_BUSY from one address is one host spraying.

entries.title: Unexpected error ended a request
entries.description: An exception nobody planned for ended a request. The caller was answered with internal-error and the correlation id; the exception and its stack trace are in this log message.
entries.action: Find the log line by the correlation id the caller quotes, and fix the cause. A burst of them is an incident.

entries.title: Problem missing from the error dictionary
entries.description: A service answered a problem whose code is not in the error dictionary, so it got a title made from its name. CI should have refused it.
entries.action: Add the code to cm-error-dictionary.json and run node scripts/error-dictionary.mjs --write.

entries.title: Sign-in code limit lifted for some addresses
entries.description: Keycloak started with addresses exempt from the limit on sign-in codes sent to one address (ADR-061). That is for the local stack, where a test kit signs in as the same accounts many times an hour.
entries.action: In production this is a misconfiguration: remove spi-authenticator-cm-otp-authenticator-exempt-addresses from Keycloak's settings and restart it.

entries.title: Unknown document
entries.description: The document named to accept is not one of the consent manager documents: terms or dpa.
entries.action: Name terms or dpa.

entries.title: Document version not current
entries.description: The version offered for acceptance is not the version in force, so the acceptance was refused. The detail names the current version.
entries.action: Read the current version (GET /api/df-reg/me/terms), show it to the Owner and accept that one.

entries.title: Fiduciary suspended
entries.description: The fiduciary this API key belongs to has been suspended by the consent manager. Nothing new is accepted until it is resumed; its records are untouched.
entries.action: Contact the consent manager's support. The suspension reason was given to your Owner.

entries.title: Fiduciary cannot be suspended
entries.description: Only an active fiduciary can be suspended; this one is pending or already suspended.
entries.action: Check the fiduciary's status.

entries.title: Fiduciary is not suspended
entries.description: Only a suspended fiduciary can be resumed.
entries.action: Check the fiduciary's status.

entries.title: Fiduciary is leaving
entries.description: The fiduciary this API key belongs to has asked to leave the platform. Nothing new is accepted during the wind-down; its records stay readable until it closes.
entries.action: An Owner can cancel the departure once before the wind-down ends, in the DF Console.

entries.title: Fiduciary cannot leave now
entries.description: Only an active or suspended fiduciary can ask to leave; this one is pending, already leaving or closed.
entries.action: Check the fiduciary's status.

entries.title: Fiduciary is not leaving
entries.description: There is no departure to cancel.
entries.action: Check the fiduciary's status.

entries.title: Departure already cancelled once
entries.description: A departure can be called off once, and this fiduciary has already used that.
entries.action: The wind-down continues. Contact the consent manager's support if this is a mistake.

entries.title: Closing a fiduciary failed
entries.description: A fiduciary whose wind-down has ended could not be closed: a step failed, such as ending its consents or removing its team. It stays LEAVING and is tried again on the next pass; every step can be repeated.
entries.action: Read the log line for the failing step, fix the cause (often cm-cns-cmd-svc or Keycloak unreachable) and it closes on the next pass.

entries.title: No legal hold to release
entries.description: The fiduciary is not under a legal hold.
entries.action: Check the fiduciary's status.

entries.title: Retention purge of a fiduciary failed
entries.description: Deleting a closed fiduciary's records past their retention failed: one of cm-cns-cmd-svc, cm-cns-qry-svc or cm-aud-svc could not be reached or refused. Nothing partly deleted is lost; every call can be repeated.
entries.action: Read the log line for the failing service, fix the cause and the next hourly pass retries.

entries.title: A proposal already waits
entries.description: A proposal to end or keep this fiduciary's contract already waits for a second member of staff.
entries.action: Approve, reject or withdraw the waiting proposal first.

entries.title: A second person must decide
entries.description: The member of staff who proposed this cannot approve or reject it: ending a contract takes two people.
entries.action: Ask another administrator to decide it.

entries.title: Proposal already decided
entries.description: The proposal was already approved, rejected or withdrawn.
entries.action: Nothing more to do; propose again if it is still wanted.

entries.title: Proposal not found
entries.description: There is no such proposal.
entries.action: Check the proposal id.

entries.title: Export not available now
entries.description: The organisation's data can be exported while it is active, suspended or leaving. Once it has closed its team and keys are gone and the records are kept only for their retention.
entries.action: Take the export during the wind-down.

entries.title: Too many sign-up requests
entries.description: Too many applications were made from this address or for this contact address, or sign-up is busy today.
entries.action: Try again later; a person is held to three applications a day for one contact address.

entries.title: Confirmation link not valid
entries.description: The link to confirm an application's contact address is not valid, has expired or was already used.
entries.action: Apply again to get a new link.

entries.title: Organisation already registered
entries.description: An organisation is already registered with this contact address.
entries.action: Sign in to the DF Console, or contact the platform.

entries.title: Application cannot be rejected
entries.description: Only an application still waiting for activation can be rejected.
entries.action: Check the fiduciary's status.

entries.title: Fiduciary cannot be activated
entries.description: Only an application waiting for activation can be activated: this one is already active, or was suspended, closed or rejected.
entries.action: Check the fiduciary's status.

entries.title: No email address to use
entries.description: Email notifications go to the address the person signed in with. They signed in with a mobile number, so there is none.
entries.action: Leave email off, or sign in with an email address.
